[TASK: 2560x1440 2K QHD 16:9 ARCHITECTURAL RELIGHTING & STATIC RECONSTRUCTION]
Transform the reference photogrammetry plate into a razor-sharp, photorealistic 6x7 medium-format architectural survey photograph.

MANDATORY TRANSFORMATION RULES:
1. PLANAR RECTIFICATION & GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat the reference image as an immutable spatial coordinate frame. Eliminate all 3D mesh polygon wobble, melted facades, and distorted rooflines. Plumb all vertical walls to true gravity vertical. Render razor-sharp ashlar courses, straight timber sash mullions, and crisp slate roofs.
2. STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the carriageway with authentic road surfacing, stone setts, whinstone kerbs, and clean flagstone pavements.
3. BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY: Overwrite all raw 3D mesh blob foliage with authentic seasonal canopy structures matching the target date. Zero green summer foliage during dormant/autumn/winter periods:
   - Canopy Composition: Specimen groves and flanking allées dominated by *Ulmus americana* 'Jefferson' and 'Princeton' (American Elm), interspersed with *Quercus phellos* (Willow Oak), *Quercus rubra* (Northern Red Oak), and *Platanus × acerifolia* (London Planetree).
- Seasonal Phenology (September 4 / Late Summer): Dense, mature full-leaf canopy volumes; foliage displays deep, late-season chlorophyll saturation with subtle initial tip chlorosis and heat-induced desiccated leaf margins on exposed upper crowns; lawn turf shows uniform active green vegetative cover intersected by compacted buff-ochre pedestrian thoroughfares.
4. OPTICAL DEPTH: Pin-sharp infinite depth of field (f/11). Zero lens blur, tilt-shift, or depth-of-field falloff across foreground and background.

[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
SOLAR LIGHT VECTOR (5400K Clean afternoon daylight with crisp directional shadows): Sun background upper-left (Azimuth 231.6°, Elevation 46.9°). backlit silhouettes with left rim lighting. shadows project forward toward lower-RIGHT.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
Medium-format 6x7 architectural aerial survey centered on the Washington Monument obelisk and Federal Triangle periphery. Tapering 169-meter marble obelisk aligned to true gravity vertical, exhibiting the distinct horizontal demarcation at 46 meters separating lower Texas Maryland calcitic marble ashlar from upper Cockeysville dolomitic marble blocks, topped by a sharp pyramidion. Concentric circular granite plaza at the obelisk base with radial crushed decomposed-gravel footpaths cutting through contiguous green turf knolls. Northeast quadrant features the National Museum of African American History and Culture, articulated with three inverted tiers of porous bronze-finished cast-aluminum lattice panels over an ultra-clear glass base and flat rooftop solar arrays. East quadrant anchored by the Neoclassical Herbert C. Hoover Building, showcasing rusticated Indiana oolitic limestone facades, giant-order Doric colonnades, and pitched red terracotta barrel-tile roofs. Flanking allées of mature Ulmus americana and Quercus phellos displaying full, dense late-summer canopies with localized leaf-margin chlorosis. Granite street curbs, paved asphalt roadways, and turf verges completely devoid of vehicles, pedestrians, barriers, or transient municipal clutter; razor-sharp structural edges, planar stone rectifications, and authentic lithic materiality.
